# cosmoner_project (Data Source)

Looks up a project. Needs `projects:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The provider's default project.
data "cosmoner_project" "current" {}

output "project_name" {
  value = data.cosmoner_project.current.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `billing_email` (String) Where invoices are sent, or null when none is set.
- `blocked` (Boolean) Whether the project is suspended. A suspended project refuses most writes.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) URL slug.
